mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_ORDER p LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON p.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE p.PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(PAYMENT_AMOUNT), 0) as totalPayment, COALESCE(SUM(WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT), 0) as totalWriteOff, COALESCE(SUM(REMAINING_AMOUNT), 0) as totalRemaining FROM TBL_PAYMENT_ORDER WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId}
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_ORDER p LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON p.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE p.SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND p.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY p.CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PAYMENT_ORDER SET WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT = #{writeOffAmount}, REMAINING_AMOUNT = PAYMENT_AMOUNT - #{writeOffAmount}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_PAYMENT_ORDER ( PAYMENT_ID, PAYMENT_NO, SUPPLIER_ID, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, WRITE_OFF_AMOUNT, REMAINING_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_METHOD, BANK_ACCOUNT, RECEIVER_ACCOUNT, RECEIVER_BANK, SUMMARY, REMARKS, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, IS_DELETED ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{paymentNo}, #{supplierId}, #{paymentAmount}, #{writeOffAmount}, #{remainingAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentDate}, #{paymentMethod}, #{bankAccount}, #{receiverAccount}, #{receiverBank}, #{summary}, #{remarks}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_PAYMENT_ORDER p LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON p.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE p.PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId}
